unique_issues.title: Unqualified guarantee of Pantone consistency
unique_issues.reason: Pantone spot colors support matching but do not guarantee identical color on every substrate, finish, and print run.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Explain PMS benefits with proofing and substrate caveats; remove absolute guarantee.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Spot UV described as embossing

evidence.quote: create a raised surface effect using spot UV coating

unique_issues.reason: Standard spot UV provides gloss contrast; a raised effect requires a specific raised-UV process.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Differentiate standard spot UV, raised spot UV, and embossing.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Overprescriptive logo placement

evidence.quote: place the logo right in the middle of the box lid for maximum visibility

unique_issues.reason: Center placement is not universally optimal across box styles, panels and shelf orientations.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Offer placement options and test placement using dielines and mockups.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Unqualified sustainability claims

evidence.quote: These inks are eco friendly and help make packaging recyclable.

unique_issues.reason: Recyclability depends on substrate, coatings, adhesive, and local collection; ink selection alone is insufficient.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Qualify recyclability and specify substrate/finish dependencies.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Repetitive sales and unboxing claims

evidence.quote: Holiday packaging is a valuable investment as it helps you generate more sales

unique_issues.reason: Similar brand exposure, sales, unboxing and perceived-value claims recur in the introduction, importance and conclusion.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Consolidate benefits and prioritize actionable design criteria.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Promotional exaggeration

evidence.quote: Your holiday gift packaging is a free marketing tool that could go viral

unique_issues.reason: Packaging is not free and virality is speculative.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Use evidence-based language about potential branded impressions.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Incomplete print-production specification guidance
unique_issues.reason: Useful production concepts are named, but no practical artwork handoff checklist covers bleed, safe area, proofs, resolution or print files.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Add print-ready logo checklist and prepress approval sequence.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Editing errors in heading and FAQ
unique_issues.reason: The intended word appears to be flattened; other passages use awkward or inconsistent capitalization.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Proofread FAQ and production terminology; use flattened two-dimensional dieline.

topic_search_intent.rationale: Promised design workflow delivered but lead overpromotes outcomes.

factual_technical_accuracy.rationale: Absolute PMS guarantee and sustainability/finishing qualifications needed.

semantic_information_value.rationale: Eight relevant design topics; repeated sales rhetoric reduces information value.

practical_decision_support.rationale: Steps usable but artwork specifications and production handoff incomplete.

content_structure_readability.rationale: Numbered workflow strong, opening and conclusion inefficient.

natural_seo_integration.rationale: Topic phrases and supporting terminology used.

b2b_commercial_relevance.rationale: Retail context clear but specification and timing guidance insufficient.

editorial_quality.rationale: Typos, grammar slips, hype and claims weaken copy.

executive_summary.strengths: Provides a practical sequence for holiday packaging design covering logo placement, themes, color palettes, finishes, dielines, print methods and preproduction mockups.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Unqualified guarantee of Pantone consistency; Spot UV described as embossing; Overprescriptive logo placement; Unqualified sustainability claims; Repetitive sales and unboxing claims.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Explain PMS benefits with proofing and substrate caveats; remove absolute guarantee.; Differentiate standard spot UV, raised spot UV, and embossing.; Offer placement options and test placement using dielines and mockups.; Qualify recyclability and specify substrate/finish dependencies.; Consolidate benefits and prioritize actionable design criteria..

source_verification.visual_exhibits: annotated published-text excerpts, NOT captured website screenshots

caveats: Wording, contradictions and structural issues were checked against published article text; some industry claims require authoritative vendor-specific validation.
